pg018_p055: A loan is money borrowed from a lender/ bank with the agreement to repay it, usually with interest over an agreed time.
pg018_p058: Interest refers to the monetary cost of borrowed money, mainly expressed as an annual percentage rate of the borrowed amount. Entrepreneurs can use loans as sources of funds to start up their small businesses.

pg018_p068: Availability of funds: Loans allow business

pg019_p008: Credit building: Responsible borrowing and timely repayment of loans can help business owners build their credit scores, which can be significant for future financial opportunities.
pg019_p013: Investment opportunities: Loans provide funds required to invest in different opportunities with the potential for high returns.
pg019_p017: Financial leverage: Borrowing money allows business owners to make more significant investments than they can afford through cash.

pg062_p035: Promotes creativity: Identifying new opportunities can lead to innovative goods or services. Entrepreneurs constantly seek new and better ways to meet customers’ needs and wants. For example, in most
